title: Unbiased Math Word Problems Benchmark for Mitigating Solving Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on Math Word Problems (MWP) after removing the question text to measure reliance on shallow heuristics and dataset artifacts rather than deep semantic understanding.

Assessing the performance penalty and sub-optimal learning that occurs when models generate mathematically equivalent solution expressions that differ from the single rigid ground-truth expression provided in standard datasets.
